page.title: Little Beasts
page.subtitle: Pure Pandamonium.
page.heroDescription: A beastly new design featuring magnetic ears or wings and UV printed front panels, and with five deceptively adorable species to choose from, including penguin, panda, shiba inu, bunny and red panda, you’re bound to find the perfect companion for you.
page.about: Formidable in every sense of the word, these apex predators never fail to strike fear into the hearts of their prey.

embed.title: Little Beasts | A Limited Edition PC by Ironside

content.title: Pure Pandamonium
content.description: They may be famous for falling out of trees, but the only thing falling here is you—head over heels in love with a Panda PC so cute, it’ll have you tumbling into a good mood every time you see it.

content.title: Don’t Worry, Be Hoppy
content.description: “You shouldn’t have gotten the bunny,” said no one ever. It’s a classic cute-thing-staple, never goes out of style, and even it did, we have a strong feeling it would bounce right back.

content.title: Toboggan, or Not Toboggan
content.description: Penguins are great swimmers, which is a good thing because this PC is so cute it may make your eyes water into a tiny puddle of joy. The Penguin is the only Little Beast to feature wings instead of ears, and we think that makes it special and less relevant that it can’t fly.

content.title: The Redder the Better
content.description: A goofy little guy who wants a spot in your goofy little heart. Red pandas basically wrote the book on cute, from pretending to be threatening to sleeping adorably in trees, as if the ground weren’t clearly more comfortable and convenient. Lucky for you, and Ironside red panda is a little more sensible and prefers the cozy comfort of your desk.

content.title: Shi-bangs, Shi-bangs!
content.description: Shibas are always kinda up to no good, don’t you think? Something about its poofy little tail and disarming little face, you have no choice but to trust it. But then you turn around and your meatball sub is on the floor next to a poof ball covered in marinara sauce. This Shiba PC isn’t like that. This shiba won’t eat your lunch, friend.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
